lines.zh: 红毛披在胸前，我走得很稳。
lines.en: Red fur across my chest, I walk steadily.
My tail sweeps slowly behind me.
One step covers a stretch of ground.

lines.zh: 爪子踩在石上，留下浅痕。
lines.en: My claws leave faint cuts in the stone.

lines.zh: 这个身体，比原来大一号。
lines.en: This body is one size bigger.

lines.zh: 我沿着山谷走，听风的缝。
lines.en: I walk the valley, listening for gaps in the wind.
A red glow moves along with me.
The ground can't take my full stride.
My fur stands up in the wind.
I hold back so I don't collapse the slope.
One swing of my tail bends a tree.
Where I walk, faint scorch marks stay.
I stand still while red light flows over me.
My claws open and close.
My tail slaps the ground, impatient.
This form is steadier, and harsher.
I'm counting how long I can hold it.
Small sparks crawl in my red fur.
Breathing slow, power full.
I look up; light shows through the clouds.
The stones under me grow hot.
I say nothing, only listen.
This fur is thicker than armour.
I clench my fist and the knuckles crack.
Standing still makes the aura louder.

lines.zh: 我在等一个值得出手的人。
lines.en: I wait for someone worth striking.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，红光压在脸上。
lines.en: I look down, red light on my face.
Don't be afraid; I know your ki.

lines.zh: 我的爪子离你只有一步。
lines.en: My claws are one step from you.
For your size, you stand well.
I narrow my eyes; the red glow slides past.
Your hands are shaking. Can't make a fist.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢偷袭，先说清楚。
lines.en: I don't like cheap shots; let's be clear.
If you want to test me, I'll answer.
This fur isn't decoration.
If you have a question, ask.
I'm rarely this polite.

lines.zh: 你的装备，看起来不便宜。
lines.en: Your gear doesn't look cheap.
Don't stand right in front; the wind's strong.
I raise a hand only to keep you still.

lines.zh: 这个形态，我脾气不太好。
lines.en: In this form my temper is short.

lines.zh: 我闷哼一声，光暗了一格。
lines.en: I grunt; the glow dims a notch.
That one bit deep.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，重新压住气。
lines.en: I step back and force my aura down.
I clench my claws and swallow the pain.
You're stronger than you look.
Thin light leaks from the wound.

lines.zh: 我吐出一口气，把血味压下去。
lines.en: I exhale and push the taste of blood away.
Fine, I stop holding back.
The red glow rises again.
Smell of meat; my stomach answers.
Food is food; I'm not picky.
Eat first, fight later, got it?
That piece in your hand, hand it over.
This form burns food faster.
I reach out and you let go.
Smells like Saiyan cooking.
I sit down and wait for my share.
Not enough; is there more?

lines.zh: 我压低身子，免得撞伤你。
lines.en: I crouch so I don't hurt you.
My red fur brushes your shoulder.
Between us, the ground cracks.
You're too light; I barely feel it.

lines.zh: 让开点，我这身毛蹭到你。
lines.en: Move aside; my fur will brush against you.
We collide and the dust rises.
Steady, don't fall back.

lines.zh: 别撞我，我正活动筋骨呢。
lines.en: Don't bump into me, I'm just warming up.
All this strength is meant to guard someone.
Someone at home is still waiting.
I promised to be back for dinner.

lines.zh: 她的气，我永远不会认错。
lines.en: I'd never mistake her ki.
I lower my hand and ease off.
She'd frown at this form.

lines.zh: 尾巴垂下来，我有点想家。
lines.en: My tail droops; I'm a bit homesick.
I promised not to be reckless.
That lamp is always left on for me.
I look up toward home.
One hand is plenty for this.
It's yours; here.
I know a senzu bean; don't waste it.
This stone feels like dirt to me.
I tuck it into my belt.
Smells of iron; not food.
I bend down and the ground creaks.
Hold it tight; don't drop it again.
Good, you're interesting.
My red glow brightens.
Ki bursts under my feet.
Ki sinks low; my staff moves first.
This strike won't be held back.

lines.zh: 十倍龟派气功，够你受的。
lines.en: A tenfold Kamehameha should do it.
You back away; I close in.
The Dragon Fist is already in my hand.
I can smell your nerves.
Don't try to circle me.
One step is all I need.
Your ki is trembling.
I've waited a long time for this.
Just you as the target; good.
One Dragon Fist and the sky splits.
I chase without breaking stride.

lines.zh: 残影留在原地，人不见了。
lines.en: An afterimage stays behind; I'm gone.
The air is where I have the edge.
The red glow trails into a line.
I know where you'll land.
Don't stop; stopping ends it.
Ki blasts follow you one by one.
My tail gets there first.
You go round the tree; I don't.
One more step and you're under my hand.
You're panting; I hear it.
I gather ki in my fist.
This path has no exit.

lines.zh: 落地时我踩出一个深坑。
lines.en: My landing leaves a deep pit.
I won't miss this one.
I'll let you come to me.
Tenfold Kamehameha!
The Dragon Fist goes straight through.

lines.zh: 我一拳轰在地上，地裂了。
lines.en: I slam the ground and it splits.
A rapid volley, dense as rain.
I grab you and slam you down.
That kick carried light.

lines.zh: 爪子划过，你的护甲开了。
lines.en: My claws pass; your armour opens.
You blocked once, and slid three paces.
The combination isn't over.
I held back; only seventy percent.
Ki bursts on my fist.

lines.zh: 我一拳砸下去，土掀到半空。
lines.en: One punch down and the earth sprays up.
The last punch, I pulled it.
The red glow arrives first, then me.
I drop out of the sky.

lines.zh: 落地时整个山谷都震了。
lines.en: The whole valley shakes as I land.

lines.zh: 大魔界的路我已经走完。
lines.en: I've finished the road of the Demon Realm.
Stones shatter at my feet.
Who woke me up?
Red fur spreads in the wind.
A light landing, a deep crater.
A flick of my tail and a tree falls.
This isn't Earth's smell.
I settle and look around.
There are a few ki signatures far off.
I pull my aura back inside.
Gravity here is light.
I'm here; be ready.

lines.zh: 火在红毛上烧，我拍了两下。
lines.en: Fire catches my fur; I beat it out.

lines.zh: 从高处落地，坑比以往深。
lines.en: Landing from high, the crater is deeper than usual.

lines.zh: 水太重，我硬撑着往上游。
lines.en: The water is heavy; I force my way up.
The blast only pushes me half a step.

lines.zh: 怪力锁住我，我用力挣开。
lines.en: Strange force locks me; I wrench free.
Too long hungry; even the glow fades.
Lightning runs along my fur.

lines.zh: 下坠时我抓不住任何东西。
lines.en: Falling, I can grip nothing.
